headline: Pakistan captain Salman Ali Agha says the team has not yet played its 'perfect game' and hopes the top order delivers in Saturday's ODI tri-series final against Sri Lanka at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Pakistan meet Sri Lanka at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore on Saturday.

caption:
Pakistan captain Salman Ali Agha says the team is still looking for its "perfect game" ahead of Saturday's ODI tri-series final against Sri Lanka at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, Dawn reports. He hopes the top order, which has been short of runs, turns up in the final.
